stories.headline: AI stocks slide after CEOs urge slower development
stories.summary: Asian AI-linked shares and US technology futures fell after the heads of Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI backed slowing frontier-model progress. The market reaction reflects concern about delays, but no binding slowdown agreement exists.

stories.headline: China builds safeguards against AI loss of control
stories.summary: Chinese policy frameworks address self-replication, autonomous resource acquisition and other loss-of-control scenarios. New agent guidelines require intervention and recovery mechanisms, though China has not adopted embedded independent monitors.

stories.headline: Economists expect Fed rate increase Wednesday
stories.summary: In a Reuters poll, 85% of economists expected a quarter-point rate increase this week after stronger inflation data. A slim majority forecast at least one additional increase by March 2027; the Fed has not announced its decision.

stories.headline: Hormuz talks postponed as regional attacks widen
stories.summary: Gulf states postponed planned talks with Iran while Houthis launched another attack on Saudi Arabia. Oil prices rose as the Saudi pipeline shutdown and disrupted Strait of Hormuz traffic intensified supply concerns.

stories.headline: Russian drone strikes train close to Polish border
stories.summary: A Russian drone hit a passenger train about 1.2 miles from Poland shortly after European diplomats used the route. No casualties were reported. Moscow said it targeted infrastructure supporting European military cargo.
